learnings.description: What the item taught, new or updated. Empty when it taught nothing worth keeping.

updates.description: The ID of the existing learning this refines (L-0017), or "" for a new one.

kind.description: rule: a finding that turned out right. false-positive: what not to flag, and why. map: what a module does. decision: the human's ruling on an escalation.

scope.description: Globs of the repo paths it applies to, as narrow as is true (apps/api/src/webhooks/**). [] only when it applies anywhere.

lens.description: The review lens it informs, or "".

source.description: Where it came from: H-0042/F1 for a finding, H-0042 for the item.

title.description: One sentence: the learning itself, specific and checkable.

body.description: Two to five sentences: when it applies, why, and how to tell. No code copied from the repo.

retire.description: IDs of existing learnings this item shows are wrong or obsolete.

gazette.description: The words for the item's Gazette: a newspaper page about it, written for a person who didn't watch it happen. Hallmark adds every date, count and cost itself.

kicker.description: Two or three words over the headline: the part of the product it touches (The web app).

headline.description: A plain headline of at most twelve words: what a person can do now, or what no longer goes wrong.

deck.description: One sentence under the headline: the outcome, and how the review went.

story.description: Three to five short paragraphs: what was asked and why, what changed for the person using it, how it works in a sentence or two, and anything the review changed.

rounds.description: One short line per review round, in plain words (Not safe to ship: the key could leak).

findings.description: Each finding in plain words: a headline a person understands, and one or two sentences on what went wrong for them and what changed.

diagram.description: An outline of the flow the change adds or changes, drawn left to right. Leave nodes and edges empty when a picture wouldn't help.
